title: fishing line
summary: MSUI now draws current Benilla's engine fishing line for every rendered local or observed unit whose held mainhand prop authors the $CCH marker while that unit channels at a streamed type-17 FISHINGNODE. The near endpoint follows the prop's current hand attachment frame; the far endpoint is the bobber placement base plus half its scaled authored bounding-box height. The opaque, depth-tested, unlit strip has exactly 65 vertices and the fixed 0.5-world-unit half-sine sag. Focused clinical and solution builds pass; a live fishing scene remains the visual acceptance step.

openItems.text: In a live desktop session, fish beside another visible fisher and confirm both local and observed lines follow the held $CCH rod tip, meet the bobber waterline center, sag by a fixed 0.5 world unit, depth-occlude against scene geometry, and disappear as soon as channel authority clears.
